purpose.fix: Recognize a bounded Portuguese purpose-of-project relation and use the same intent for canonical lexical selection and compound-relation identification. No ranking or authority threshold changes.

previous_attempts.raw: Você planeja usar o PostgreSQL no seu projeto, mas não há registro sobre qual banco de dados o seu irmão usa.

concrete_causes: Native context_facts::project marked only technical execution records historical after terminal project status. The preceding database plan was injected as validity=current alongside current lifecycle cancelled.

The first response joined its own planning relation with an independent absence statement introduced by enquanto. The verifier treated the embedded brother-owned usa as execution of the PostgreSQL plan.
The regenerated present-tense planeja was not execution by the lexical verifier, and the native plan was still tagged current, so that false current modality passed.
cancelled_plan.native_fix: For an approved terminal lifecycle, project language/database plans and decisions grounded in an earlier original source remain recoverable as historical facts with unchanged modality and record version. Prefer native source reservation order over approval time, with timestamp fallback for preexisting records lacking job provenance.
